text: Instructions for Teachers and Parents The curriculum for the Foundational Stage has been designed as per the SCF 2024 prepared by SCERT Maharashtra, Pune. The content in this textbook is derived from the sources that relate and reflect the children’s experiences. Along with play-based activities and enquiry-based learning, it includes a focus on developing social skills. This book attains optimal outcomes in the domains like physical and motor development, cognitive development, socio-emotional development, ethical development, cultural / aesthetic development, the development of communication and early language literacy. It is assumed that children learn best through play, interaction and hands-on activities. Here are some effective strategies to help them develop language, creativity and social skills through different language components. Here’s how teachers and parents can make learning an enjoyable experience by exploring these topics by fun and engaging methods. It is expected that the teachers / parents will follow the instructions given in the textbook to ensure the best learning experiences. Phonological awareness • Introduce sound/s of each letter. • Help them to build words instead of rote learning. • Show them how to break words into syllables and vice versa. Poems • Sing the poems / songs with rhythm and action. • Ask children to replace some words to extend or create a new poem. Stories • Use props while enacting the story. • Encourage children to use their imagination. • Provide access to the children to read books of their choice. Conversation / Picture talk • Provide real-life situations to develop speaking skills. • Give ample practice of conversation. • Provide word bank for the picture talk and encourage conversation. Games / puzzles / riddles • Reinforce vocabulary through games, puzzles and riddles. • Design more games to give ample practice. Recipes / Art / Craft activites • Give hands-on experience while teaching recipe, art and craft activities. • Inculcate good healthy eating habits through talks and discussion. • Ask children to work in a group to develop social skills. Teaching book handling and inculcating reading habits • Introduce different types of books available in the library. • Show them how to turn pages gently. Reading • Develop reading habit. • Help to improve reading by mastering phonetic awareness and proper intonation. Writing • Make sure that development of listening and speaking is acquired before developing writing skills. • Ensure that child listens properly before taking dictation. • Words given below the lessons must be used for the dictation. • Develop a proper pattern of writing (e.g. spacing between words and use of punctuation marks.)  Draw picture See and do Listen Read Listen and act Activity Do Colour the picture Speak/ Discuss Write Sing a song Enact For the Teacher Logos used in the Textbook
